title: Cold Clinic
description: Open a protected channel for a clinic’s patients and backup controller.
objective: Evacuate protected identities at Authoritative record / Capture controller at Response controller
condition: All required objectives must be secured. Optional archives pay extra. Quiet bonus uses peak trace.
aftermath: The clinic’s outage was a test of how long volunteers would share their batteries.

lore.text: SABLE / community grid engineer: Open a protected channel for a clinic’s patients and backup controller. The sender asks you to keep the names attached to the evidence; anonymous totals have concealed people before.
